fixture.name: small-dynamic-ssr
fixture.description: One dynamic SSR route rendering the same 120-item list and shared CSS in each framework.

methodology.cache: Generated framework caches removed before dev and build; OS filesystem and any product-enabled Node compile cache warm
methodology.nodeCompileCache: Ambient Node compile-cache controls removed; framework CLIs retain their normal compile-cache behavior
methodology.responseTransport: Node HTTP/1.1 with explicit decoding (v2; not directly comparable to the prior Fetch transport)
methodology.responseBodyBytes: Encoded and decoded HTTP body bytes; excludes headers, chunk framing, and TLS. responseBytes is the legacy decoded-size alias.
methodology.devFirstPage: Framework process spawn to the first HTTP 200 containing the expected rendered marker
methodology.cleanBuild: Framework build process spawn to successful exit after generated-cache removal
methodology.productionBoot: Built production process spawn to the first HTTP 200 containing the expected marker
methodology.responseLatency: Sequential full-body loopback HTTP requests with a fresh connection, including decompression and UTF-8 decoding; validation and warmups excluded
methodology.productionCommand: Recommended framework production command; Next.js uses next start and every other row uses a generated server entry

quality.contentionRule: At least three frameworks exceeding 1.5× their own median build time in the same round; assessment requires at least three frameworks and three measured rounds
